## Dataset selection and plan

I used the 2024 Census education table (B15003). The file I downloaded has numbers for the whole United States, so I compared education levels nationally. I also kept the margins of error in the data. I did not compare states because this file does not have state-level numbers.

## Original source and planned output

Official table: [2024 ACS B15003](https://data.census.gov/table/ACSDT5Y2024.B15003). I kept the original CSV under `data/raw/`. It contains the category labels and two wide measurement columns: the estimate and its margin of error.

In the Code Base, I use `pivot_longer()`, make a summary table, and create a chart. I leave the downloaded CSV unchanged.
